intro.en: Xaihi is a Sessionite from Laterano's Cabal of Tranquility who joined Endfield Industries on the Abbess's recommendation and now handles information engineering aboard Dijiang.
intro.zh-TW: 賽希是來自拉特蘭寂語修會會話派的成員，經院長引薦加入終末地工業，現於帝江號負責資訊工程事務。

basic.en: Cryo combo of up to 5 hits. While she is the controlled operator, her Final Strike deals 15 Stagger.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 5 段的寒冷傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊造成 15 點失衡。

battle.en: Summons an Auxiliary Crystal around the controlled operator that heals them after they land a Final Strike, up to 2 times, scaling with Will. If the operator is already at Max HP when healed, it also grants a non-stacking Arts Amp for a time.
battle.zh-TW: 召喚支援晶體環繞主控幹員一段時間，主控幹員重擊命中後為其回復生命值，最多觸發 2 次，治療量受意志加成。觸發時若生命值已滿，還會施加一段時間無法疊加的法術增幅。

combo.en: Trigger: the Auxiliary Crystal uses up its HP treatments. She briefly charges the Auxiliary Crystal and launches it at the enemy, dealing Cryo damage and applying Cryo Infliction.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：支援晶體的生命回復次數耗盡。短暫蓄力後將支援晶體擲向敵人，造成寒冷傷害並施加寒冷附著。

ultimate.en: Grants temporary Cryo Amp and Nature Amp to the whole team, with the Amp values boosted by Intellect.
ultimate.zh-TW: 對全隊施加一段時間的寒冷增幅與自然增幅，增幅效果隨智識提高。

talents.en: When Stress Testing hits an enemy that already has Cryo Infliction or Solidification, that enemy takes 7% more Cryo damage (10% at Promotion II) for 5 s; this does not stack.
talents.zh-TW: 壓力測試命中已處於寒冷附著或凍結狀態的敵人時，使其受到的寒冷傷害 +7%（精英化II 為 +10%），持續 5 秒，無法疊加。

talents.en: Stack Overflow also dispels Cryo Infliction and Solidification from the whole team.
talents.zh-TW: 堆疊溢位同時會淨化全隊的寒冷附著與凍結狀態。

potentials.en: The Auxiliary Crystal's Arts Amp is increased by an extra 5%.
potentials.zh-TW: 支援晶體提供的法術增幅額外提升 5%。

potentials.en: Stack Overflow costs 10% less Ultimate Energy.
potentials.zh-TW: 堆疊溢位所需的終結技能量 -10%。

potentials.en: On hit, Stress Testing chains 1 time to 1 other nearby target.
potentials.zh-TW: 壓力測試命中目標時，會對周圍 1 個其他目標彈射 1 次。

potentials.en: Stack Overflow's Amp effect is increased to 1.1 times its original value.
potentials.zh-TW: 堆疊溢位的增幅效果提升為 1.1 倍。
